name: Mizuabi Kouen de Deatta Shoujo Runa
original_name: 水浴び公園で出会った少女 るな
source:
In summer the park is a lolicon paradise!
Wet little girls without any underpants frolic in the fountains.
One girl in particular named Runa stands out.
Something is more mature about her... she's enticing, like she knows what she wants. Could she be a little nympho? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE136880.html]DLsite English[/url]]
